capture_source: live captures 2026-11-26, ABAP Platform 2025 (kernel 916), Unicode: ABAP sending bgRFC units through a registered destination (bgRFC protocol, basXML) to a registered server, first the reference SDK's (pyrfc 3.3.1 on the NW RFC SDK 7.50), then saprfclib's RfcServer. Each unit was created in ABAP (CL_BGRFC_DESTINATION_OUTBOUND) and committed.
sanitised: length-preserving, in ASCII and UTF-16LE and as the raw IPv4 bytes in 0x0514: server address -> 198.51.100.9, client host -> 'host1', operating-system user -> 'osuser000001'. SDATA is decompressed, substituted and compressed again with saprfclib's LZH, so its plaintext is as captured and its compressed bytes are not.
evidence: tier 1 live capture; the ABAP-side outcomes noted per case are tier 3 probes
frames: the RFC records after the 80-byte gateway header, one call or answer each

reference.note: T: STFC_CONNECTION; D: Z_SAPRFCLIB_DEEP2 (deep structure and string table) then STFC_CONNECTION; Q: STFC_CONNECTION in queue ZSAPRFCLIB_OQ. Each was checked, run, committed, then confirmed in a second conversation.

saprfclib.note: ABAP accepted the answer and confirmed the unit; units D and Q in the same session ran with their values decoded and were confirmed as well.

saprfclib_handler_failed.note: The handler raised 'unit handler exploded'. ABAP sent no confirm and recorded the message as the unit's error, to retry it.

saprfclib_already_executed.note: The check callback reported the unit as executed; no handler ran. ABAP took the answer as success and confirmed the unit.
